visual_synopsis: A school group of teenagers led by a bespectacled female teacher in a black coat and orange scarf walks around a wintry zoo past donkey, goat and camel enclosures. A scruffy zookeeper in an olive coat and grey ushanka, leaning on a long broom, holds forth to them and to camera in front of the animal pens.
